# Support

## Getting Help

If you need help with Value Ledger, there are several resources available:

### Documentation

- [README](../README.md) - Project overview and quick start
- [User Manual](../docs/user-manual.md) - CLI commands and Python API usage
- [Specs Sheet](../docs/specs-sheet.md) - Complete specification and protocols
- [Contributing Guide](../docs/contributing.md) - Development setup and guidelines

### Issues

For bug reports and feature requests, please use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/kase1111-hash/value-ledger/issues):

- **Bug Reports**: Use the bug report template to report issues
- **Feature Requests**: Use the feature request template to suggest improvements

Before opening a new issue:
1. Search existing issues to avoid duplicates
2. Check the documentation for answers
3. Provide as much detail as possible

### Security Issues

**Do NOT report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

For security-related issues, please see our [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md) for proper reporting procedures.

### Discussions

For general questions, ideas, and discussions, check the [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/kase1111-hash/value-ledger/discussions) (if enabled) or open an issue with the `question` label.

## Response Times

This is an open-source project maintained by volunteers. We aim to:

- Acknowledge issues within 1 week
- Respond to security issues within 48 hours
- Review pull requests within 2 weeks

Response times may vary based on maintainer availability.

## Agent-OS Ecosystem

Value Ledger is part of the Agent-OS ecosystem. For questions about related projects:

- [Agent-OS](https://github.com/kase1111-hash/Agent-OS)
- [IntentLog](https://github.com/kase1111-hash/IntentLog)
- [Boundary Daemon](https://github.com/kase1111-hash/boundary-daemon-)
- [Memory Vault](https://github.com/kase1111-hash/memory-vault)
- [NatLangChain](https://github.com/kase1111-hash/NatLangChain)

## Contributing

Interested in contributing? See our [Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) to get started.
